name: Lyo.Email.Models
tagline: Shared models, options, failure codes, and event payloads for the `Lyo.Email` SMTP sender.
description: Shared models, options, failure codes, and event payloads for the [`Lyo.Email`](../Lyo.Email/README.md) SMTP sender.

sections.title: Request and result types
items: `EmailRequest`. Sender, recipients, subject, optional `TextBody` / `HtmlBody`, and optional attachment metadata carried as the `Result<EmailRequest>.Data` payload.
`EmailAttachment`. File name and bytes, plus optional `ContentType` and `MetadataJson`. The logging schema does not persist attachment bytes.
`EmailResult`. `Result<EmailRequest>` that adds `MessageId`, `SentDate`, and `SmtpResponse`. Built via `EmailResult.FromSuccess`, `EmailResult.FromException`, and `EmailResult.FromError`.

sections.title: Options
items: `EmailServiceOptions`. Settings for `EmailService` (host, port, SSL, default sender, optional SMTP credentials, metrics toggle, `BulkEmailConcurrencyLimit` (default `10`), `MaxBulkEmailLimit` (default `1000`), `MaxAttachmentCountPerEmail` (default `20`)). Section name constant: `EmailServiceOptions.SectionName = "EmailServiceOptions"`.

sections.title: Failure codes
rows: The builder could not produce a message.

sections.title: Event payloads
items: `EmailSendingEventArgs(EmailRequest EmailRequest)`. Raised before a single send.
`EmailSentEventArgs(EmailResult EmailResult)`. After one send (success or failure). `EmailResult` carries `MessageId`, `SentDate`, and `SmtpResponse`.
`EmailBulkSendingEventArgs(IReadOnlyList<EmailRequest> BulkEmailMessage)`. Before a bulk send starts.
`BulkEmailSentEventArgs(BulkResult<EmailRequest> BulkEmailResult)`. After a bulk send finishes.
`ConnectionTestedEventArgs(bool IsSuccess, TimeSpan ElapsedTime, Exception? Exception)`. After `TestConnectionAsync` finishes.
